choice_context: Selection between competing movie options based on expressed preference themes
reasoning: Identified unipolar features by clustering thematically related themes while maintaining distinct dimensions. Prioritized features that subsume high-frequency themes and capture meaningful variation in viewer preferences.

dimensions.name: Emotional Depth

low_pole.label: Emotionally Neutral
low_pole.description: Minimal character development or emotional engagement
low_pole.typical_person: Viewers prioritizing plot over character arcs

high_pole.label: Highly Emotional
high_pole.description: Rich character development and emotional resonance

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on presence of complex emotional character arcs and thematic depth
